name: Grogu Mini Capsule
packagingNote: A mini capsule holds ONE Grogu, not four figures. Every one of these is Grogu doing something different.
sourced: 12 figures. The checklist published on the Doorables wiki. Just Play has not published a checklist for this line, so treat it as very good community data rather than gospel.
codeLinkLabel: Grogu Mini Capsule on the Doorables wiki
codeNote: Partial collector code coverage: look for the batch letter and number on the bottom or back of the package. The public Star Wars sheet calls this line Grogu 2. TL001 is reported as Anzellan Hug; C017 has reports for Anzellan Hug and Macaron Cookie, so both alternatives are shown. These reports are unofficial, not a manufacturer guarantee.
countNote: Partial code coverage: reports currently identify only 2 of the 12 Grogu figures. The other 10 remain on the checklist, but their package codes have not been mapped.
